limits: Two replays of one synthetic saved state with player-count override.
DB was observed at selector writes, not directly at the animation helper entry or return.
The route from the helper to the selector has no data-bank changes, but these hooks do not prove every intervening call.
Helper counter, table variant and exact entry timing were not recorded.
The reload return uses the supplied restored DB value; graphics side effects are not modeled.
Frame intervals are observations, not general timing rules.
